Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher when our other one broke, and wasn't reasobably repairable after just a few years.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher with some caveats ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher when our other one broke, and wasn't reasobably repairable after just a few years. The repair person said that Bosch appliances are solid and rarely need repair so we picked up the 500 series. Generally, I like this dishwasher. It's incredibly configurable and does a fantastic job at cleaning dishes. The heating element isn't exposed so it's safe to put dishwaser safe plastics in the bottom rack which is awesome. Also, unlike many other dishwashers, the top (3rd) shelf is very handy (we removed it from our previous dishwasher as it was basically useless) and it has some really nice features, like automatically popping open the door when it's finished to facilite drying. I do have a couple of issues with it however. My biggest, by far, is that to use most of the features, you have to use the app. If you want to use the dishwasher without the app, the functionalty is pretty limited. I get that being able to monitor the progress of a wash and scheduling when you want it to run is handy but I feel like I should be able to perform most other functions, like simply delaying the start, without having to use an app - and you really can't. My only other (very minor) complaint is that the included utensil holder is tiny. My family is just two people so it's only an issue if we have friends over, but if you have a large family, and if you cook very much, you're probably going to want to buy a 3rd party holder. Generally, this is a really good appliance. It's configurability is awesome and you really can just scrape off the leftover gunk and throw the dishes in the washer, but it's reliance on the app, for me at least, makes it less than ideal.

Sentence (English): 2 months and still amazed at the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Fantastic KitchenAid Front Control Dishwaster ] || ---------------- || 2 months and still amazed at the dishwasher. It was to replace an 8-year old KitchenAid that stopped washing. We have used this new dishwasher on average 5 times a week - we enjoy cooking every day and my wife is a professional chef,. There were a couple of times when the dishes were not dried (we only use the ProWash cycle) but that was probably due to bad placement in upper tray. Otherwise, it runs at 1/4 the sound level of the older KitchenAid. We commented last evening how wonderful it was to have squeaky clean dishes again. Am hoping this one will last at least 8 years. The previous KitchenAid had the control hidden on the top of the door. This dishwasher has the panel beveled into the front of the door and I like not to have to bend over to see why the machine had not started (blinking LED), re-open and press the start button again. Plus the steam would leak into the old machine's top panel and I think that is why some of the functions failed (and discolored the panel to off brown and black which you can't clean up). And a lesson learned - we did not want the control panel on the front of the door (our oven has that feature) because sometimes we turn it on by accident when we brush up against it reaching inside the microwave which is above the oven and counter. The delivery team carefully delivered the dishwasher into the kitchen and unpacked it. They measured the opening and it was perfectly sized (I had measured the opening before ordering) and when they saw the 12-gauge wire coming out from the wall, they wanted to charge $350 for converting it. I told them we would install it. All we had to do was connect the 12-gauge wire from my wall to the box in the dishwasher's power core junction box. My 18-yo son and I did that task together and we completed it in 20 minutes.

Sentence (English): I have always had dishwashers, washing machines, refrigerators.
Comments (English): [ Detergent flavored dishes ] || ---------------- || I have always had dishwashers, washing machines, refrigerators. Bosch, but I'm afraid this will be the last. From the first day this dishwasher, which has cost me a fortune, always brings out the dishes that taste like detergent. In plates and glasses it is not very noticeable, but in Tupperware or plastic utensils the flavor is embedded and the food tastes like detergent because of it. I have changed tupperware and kitchen utensils several times but they always get flavor again. The truth is that the previous device, which was 10 years old, worked much better than this one. The technical service does not give me a solution either, since they do not detect any fault, so I think this will be my last Bosch appliance.
Comments (Original): [ Vajilla con sabor a detergente ] || ---------------- || Siempre he tenido lavavajillas, lavadoras, neveras... Bosch, pero me temo que este será el último. Desde el primer día este lavavajillas, que me ha costado un dineral, saca siempre la vajilla con sabor a detergente. En platos y vasos no se nota mucho, pero en tuppers o utnesilios de plástico el sabor se incrusta y la comida sabe a detergente por ello. He cambiado varias veces de tuppers y de utensilios de cocina pero vuelven a coger sabor siempre. La verdad es que funcionaba mucho mejor el anterior aparato, que tenía 10 años, que este. El servicio técnico tampoco me da una solución, ya que no detectan ningún fallo, por lo que creo que este será mi último elecotrodoméstico Bosch.

Sentence (English): I have had it for 2 months and I dearly miss my old Maytag.
Comments (English): [ Poor design of the racks ] || ---------------- || I have had it for 2 months and I dearly miss my old Maytag. The only advantage of this dishwasher is that it is quiet. The layout of the racks is terrible. Space between the bottom and the middle rack is too big, leaving not enough space for the middle rack. I like the idea of the top rack for the utensils, but that is outweighed by the bad design of the bottom rack. The gaps between the rods at the bottom are so big that smaller bowls and containers fall through, while bigger dishes are too heavy for the flimsy rods to hold, and their bottoms drop below the rods and get stuck on the threshold. I used to load many more miscellaneous dishes, bowls, small pots and containers in my old dishwasher, this one is only good for the households that use a lot of flat plates and little else. I now have to wash many more things by hand, which kills all the advantages of their supposedly efficient use of water.

Sentence (English): Prior to making this purchase, I read many reviews about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very quiet dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Prior to making this purchase, I read many reviews about this dishwasher. Those reviews varied in opinions and experiences but majority of folks loved it. Our courier delivered our unit and were able to install it. They had all of the materials to install and for a fee, offered to install a gfci outlet for us. We had prepped the area for our installers (disconnecting and removing our old dishwasher) and they had spent about 20 minutes. I would have to say, our first 10 runs of the dishwasher, I was getting a little worried. Some of the reviewers had mentioned this dishwasher being louder than they had anticipated. I read somewhere that this sound is the recirculating pump that's making the noise. I poured water to fill up the tub and the subsequent washes were very quiet. Now that we have had at least 30 washes, I don't think I hear it much and it is indeed very quiet. Perhaps it needed breaking in? Our dishes come out very clean and dry. I really like the third rack that comes with it. It holds a lot of dishes and makes better use of space than our previous two rack whirlpool dishwasher we had replaced after 10 years. This 405 model is newer than the 404 model. I couldn't find the listed difference other than it's newer. One of the things we're still having to get use to is not accidently touching the controls. The control panel is quite sensitive. For those who need to anchor this onto quartz or stone counter top, you may want to consider purchasing granite grabbers, which will stick right underneath your counters and provide anchoring points. It won't last forever, but we didn't want to drill holes into our cabinet or use epoxy on our counters. Don't forget to purchase dishwasher cleaner (the tablets used to wash and deodorize your dishwasher). We hope this review is helpful and we are sure you will love this dishwasher! Costco has the best price and service in town!

Sentence (English): I had a Whirlpool that was 6 years old when it finally broke down.
Comments (English): [ Not Too Happy With This Model ] || ---------------- || I had a Whirlpool that was 6 years old when it finally broke down. I paid about $100 more than the cost of a repair to buy this model. I'm not as pleased with the new model compared to the old. The previous dishwasher worked very well. Unfortunately the sump pump went out and the tech wanted $452 to repair it. This dishwasher has a plastic tub where my old one was stainless steel. This model doesn't dry the dishes as well. If I don't use the extra dry function and the heated wash option, the dishes come out wet. The door creaks when opened and the utensil basket is positioned in the lower rack and takes up a lot of space. It's very difficult to load pots and pans, so I often have to remove the basket. The old model's basket was in the door and provided much more room for large items. The dishes do come out clean, but are not dry if I use just the normal cycle without the extended dry and heated wash cycle. The 3rd pull out shelf at the top is designed for tableware and is covered in raised plastic guides to hold forks, spoons, etc. This is a problem because I can't put larger cooking utensils like wooden spoons and spatulas, etc. on it and close the door. My old model did allow for larger items on the 3rd upper tray.

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Nice Upgrade.  ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch dishwasher. The first one lasted 12 years and we really liked it. I was going to repair it but this was not cost effective. The new one is a nice upgrade. Some features are the same but the new look really compliments our newly renovated kitchen. I am a DIY'er and installation was very straight forward. The fit and finish are first class. Operation is very quiet and the dishes come out sparkling clean. I really like the top controls; they give a nice clean modern look. The old one had forward controls and they tend to collect grime. The red light that shines on the floor while it's running is really helpful because my wife and I are hearing impaired. Some things I would add, please include a paper operation manual, I had to print one out. Secondly, the silver screws that attach the white finish panel at the bottom look tacky. They should be painted white to match the panel. I bought white screw caps to cover them. This is a better option and adds a finished, high-quality look and costs pennies.

There are a lot of cleaning options and also a lot of racks, which are the positive parts of the this dishwasher. Super quiet and you can't even hear it, even if you try. Also, the crystal drying option, which is the biggest selling point of this dishwahser is the worst part of it. The dishes are still super wet after the whole cycle plus the crystal dry. Also, inside the dishwasher has not way to vent the moisture; so, it is always wet. I think the previous series with the airdrye feature is the better option, and a lot more cheaper. I recommend this dishwasher, only if are are okey to drop a big bucks. But I feel even Bosch has better options with cheaper prices, like previous series.

Sentence (English): The product itself is great.
Comments (English): [ PLEASE READ: Beware of the Installers! ] || ---------------- || The product itself is great. No major complains except the tines are sparse at the lower rack, so the capacity for plates are about 40% less than my previous one. READ THIS: The installers arrived, and promptly claimed that GFCI must be done instead of direct wiring and that the "pdf instructions says so". I only received a receipt from Costco. Nothing about the pre-install. They then claimed that "any air gap older than 1 years old must be replaced due to the pressure." quote-unquote. I asked them what pressure? They mumbled something about "Code". Then the installers said that the old dishwasher could not be removed due to a dripping valve. I looked, and indeed it seemed to be dripping and I don't understand why since it hasn't dripped before. So I shut off the main water valve and they said they still cannot do anything. They said that they can replace the valve, the air gap, and put in a GFCI for $200. I asked them if they are licensed electricians and they said no. I declined, then disconnected the line from the valve myself while they watched. It turns out that the installer left a tiny 1/8 turn on the valve so it was not closed all the way - that's why it was dripping! They took the old unit away and I hired a licensed electrician to install the GFC. Then went to HD to get a new airgap ($9.89) and not surprisingly, it looks just like my old one. I asked HD employee how long have they been selling this brand/model airgap and the guy said "as long as I've been working here - probably 6 years or so." Moral of the story: the Installers want to make a quick buck but this is NOT the way to do it. I complained to Costco and they immediately apologized and sent a different crew which turned out to be fantastic. So just be aware. Don't fall for the tricks.

Since it is a continuously upgraded home appliance, you can experience a dishwasher that becomes new every time you use it. Sentence (English): First, I live single so I don't use the dishwasher often.
Comments (English): [ This is a great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || First, I live single so I don't use the dishwasher often. I have had it long enough now to have used it about 8 times and so far I am very pleased. The dishwasher has a very sleek design and is very easy to use. The dishes come out clean and dry and I have only ever used the shorter one-hour cycle which is more than enough to do the job. I have hard water and my previous dishwasher left hard water deposits on my dishes and I have not experienced that with this one.I love that the interior is stainless steel. This was a must for me and the interior is also clean after a cycle completes, without water spots remaining on the steel. I know this is a small thing but it matters to me. When the cycle completes, it alerts you with a gentle chime. I also like that there are areas on both lower racks where you can fold down portions to accommodate larger objects, which is a very nice detail. It also has a very shallow top rack which is another nice feature. Note to self and all others who have not had a top rack before - do not put lids in it - they will capture and retain a ton of water. Now I know! This dishwasher is also wireless enabled though I have not downloaded the app nor used it. I simply have no need.Although the dishwasher is relatively quiet and comparable to my old one, I have heard it make a wide variety of strange noises while it's running and the sounds can vary from load to load, which is a bit odd. I guess maybe this has something to do with the way it was loaded? And although I already mentioned some nice feature of all of the racks, they feel a bit flimsier than I would expect and I therefore have not and will not load it to capacity.

Sentence (English): We bought this Samsung dishwasher primarily for it's low dBA rating.
Comments (English): [ Super quiet, but poor performance ] || ---------------- || We bought this Samsung dishwasher primarily for it's low dBA rating. In that respect, it didn't disappoint. This thing is SUPER quiet. But its performance as an actual dishwasher left us highly disappointed. Dishes are NEVER dry when it completes a cycle. We've gone into the settings, making sure the Auto-Open setting was enabled (which the manual says helps the dishes dry), but it still doesn't open when a cycle is completed (it only opened the very first time we used it, never again). A normal wash cycle also takes a whopping 2.5 hrs. Additionally, the rack 'fingers', the parts that are designed to hold plates upright, aren't very good. Dishes always fall over, never able to stay upright. Samsung engineering of this unit has left us very disappointed. Our previous dishwasher (a Kitchenaid which lasted 17 years) was far superior; we should have stayed with that brand. We're highly considering contacting Costco and seeing if they'd take this Samsung back.

Sentence (English): We had an old Thermador dishwasher that started to fall apart.
Comments (English): [ NOT Ultra Quiet, among other problems ] || ---------------- || We had an old Thermador dishwasher that started to fall apart. After doing a lot of research, I decided to go with this Borsch model. Based on online reviews and specs, it was supposed to be similar to Thermador for the most part, without some of the bells and whistles of Thermador we didn't care for. As far as appearances and functions go, it seems to be identical to our old one. The buttons are slightly different. However, it is noticeably louder than the old dishwasher, even though the dBA rating on the specs is lower. You can hear the dishes clinging in there from a different room. Furthermore, the door developed an unpleasant squeak about a month after installation. Also worth mentioning is that the door latch has a loud click and cheap feel to it. Lastly, this Crytal Dry technology, which sounded very existing in their marketing material, does not seem to do anything out of the ordinary. In fact, every dishwasher we had in the past, including Thermador, did a much better job at drying. It's a very middle-of-the-road product. You will probably get the same value by spending less with other brands or have to shell out much more for it to actually be "ultra quiet" and not feel like a cheap appliance.

Comments (English): [ LG's come a long way! ] || ---------------- || I am a family member of an LG employee and I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. All opinions expressed in this post are personal and should not be attributed to LG.I just moved into my new townhome last year, so although I had a brand new Fisher & Paykel dual drawer dishwasher (which is technically a more expensive dishwasher than this LG LDPH5554), I wasn't a fan of the dual drawers - it was nice for drying my dishes after washing them by hand, but the added flexibility of having dual drawers limited its capacity and I would be unable to fit larger pots and pans into it. I'm also huge on having a smart home, so the fact that there was no WIFI connectivity was a huge miss for me. These issues are now a thing of the past thanks to my new LG LDPH5554 dishwasher! The capacity with the adjustable tines and the easily adjustable upper rack height, plus the smart connectivity features are fantastic. I also love having a stainless steel tub vs. the plastic that was on my previous dishwasher. The top controls are nicely hidden away when the door is closed, so my child can no longer randomly press buttons anymore either; but I can still tell how much time is left by looking at the elegantly hidden clock or I can just check my smartphone to see how much time is left or if a cycle is complete. In fact, my LG TVs even notify me if the cycle is done, which is super convenient if I'm upstairs. Another thing I love is the 3rd rack, which my previous dishwasher obviously didn't have. My chopsticks no longer just fall through the cutlery basket and block the spray arms, nor do my long skinny utensils awkward protrude out and potentially block the upper spray arm. I must admit, I was a bit hesitant to try out the LG dishwasher after having heard they had issues with reliability in the past, and time will still tell, but the quality of this LG dishwasher has definitely come a long way, and I'm loving it so far. I'm already looking to potentially upgrade again within the LG lineup, because I'm eyeing the smoother easy glide racks and the addition of steam, but this dishwasher, at its price point, is a fantastic model and delivers everything that I want and need in a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We searched the internet and Consumer Reports when it came time for a new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not Off to Best Start ] || ---------------- || We searched the internet and Consumer Reports when it came time for a new dishwasher. Everything today is self service. Very few models are available anywhere to actually see and touch. We really wanted a white dishwasher because I hate stainless steel because of cleaning and scratches but the model we wanted didn't come in white.installion went well but as soon as we opened the door after installation we saw several small scratches and one looked it was already rusty. No one was available in Lowe's appliances after calling three times and was told to try again later. I finally got through to a live person at Bosch customer service and they gave me the name of a repair company and said the would call me. The company did call and told me they couldn't help and told me to call Bosch back and ask for another company. Finally I was directed to a repair company who ordered a part and will call me when the part is in. All this even before we used the dishwasher. I don't understand how this machine even made it through inspection before leaving the company. Makes me wonder how well the machine will work over time.

Comments (English): [ I received an exchange for an initial defect that prevented some functions from working. Repackaging for return was a pain. My arms and legs were all worn out while covering and taping the box. The exchange was not smooth. My personal information and that of others was compromised. ] || ---------------- || I received an exchange due to an initial defect that caused some functions to malfunction. Repackaging for return was incredibly tedious. Covering the box and taping it up was a pain, and my arms and legs were all worn out. The exchange wasn't smooth. My personal information and another person's personal information were mixed up, so my phone number was mine, and my address was someone else's. My phone number was given to someone else, and the other person's address and name were exposed. I requested a consultation via KakaoTalk, but it took over an hour, so I called (I think it might be a KakaoTalk server issue). I asked them to double-check and then proceed with redelivery and pickup. It was a struggle, having to leave a large package outside, bring it back in, and then put it back outside again. Unlike last time, I didn't hear anything about delivery or pickup, so I called again (I waited for over an hour on KakaoTalk again). They said the exchange was registered, but the tracking number hadn't arrived yet. I requested pickup and delivery on Friday, and when I called again on Tuesday afternoon, the tracking number arrived, but there was no delivery information. I suspect they called and hastily scheduled a delivery, only to have the tracking number sent out. But then I received another text message at the last minute, requesting pickup from someone else's address. Please manage your personal information. Fortunately, the item arrived, but it was a stressful purchase. I hate to give it a rating, but the customer service was so friendly that I'm giving it three stars. As for the product, the mini dishwasher is about the same. Since all the mini brands have gone out of business, my options are limited, and the Minix looked good. It's a bit uncomfortable because the structure retains a small amount of water after use. It's convenient because I don't have to wash dishes in hot water in the summer. It dries cleanly even during the rainy season, which is nice. I liked Minix because of its solid concept and brand image, but I'm not so sure anymore. I wish they had better IT management.

Sentence (English): After months of deliberation, I finally decided to buy it with my own money!
Comments (English): [ After months of worrying about it, I was stressed out from the instructions after work and the piled up dishes before going to work, so I decided to buy it with my own money! I was really worried about the color, but the new color is better than I thought. ] || ---------------- || After months of deliberation, I finally decided to buy it with my own money! I was really worried about the color, but the new color is prettier than I expected. It's not too white, so I don't have to worry about stains, and the subtle oatmeal color looks great with any decor. When I first installed it, I was like, "Wasn't that all I had to do?" It was so simple that even a single woman could install it. The water tank can be separated from the washing machine, so it was easy to install. As soon as I received it, I put in some Minix detergent, ran the internal cleaning cycle, and then tried washing dishes. I'm still not used to it, so dishwashing Tetris was a challenge. The dishwasher is slightly higher than I'm used to, so it's hard to see clearly. The gaps in the trays are wider than I expected, so I felt like a dish or lid might fall through if I'm not careful. I think I'll get used to it and it'll be fine. There were a lot of complaints about the noise, but for this size and price, it's a decent product. I don't think it'll be a big deal if I run it before work or before bed. Additionally, I bought a 1,000 won clear organizer from Daiso, and it holds a perfect amount of Minix detergent. I also recommend this.

I thought it was time, so I bought it. I ordered it through Coupang Rocket Installation and it was installed on the day I wanted. I ordered it mainly because I felt like it was a waste of time washing dishes in the evening and wanted to exercise during that time. We used to have a dish dryer at home, and it was pretty good if I dried and put away the dishes right after washing them. However, I wonder if washing the dishes in the evening is strange to me because I have a lot of dishes to wash. The installer was very kind. My kitchen is very small, so the sink is complicated. There is not enough space for pots, but I installed it in that space. I took out the shelf and used it as a dishwasher right next to the kitchen, so it looks pretty neat. I just bought a wooden shelf on top and use it as a cover. At first, I didn't know how to use it well, so after drying with hot air, I opened the door all the way and it wasn't dry. I was really worried that something was wrong, but since the door opens automatically, you can just leave it as is. I run it in the evening and when the drying fan runs, the moisture is dry when I look in the morning. You shouldn't open the door wide to dry it. I bought powder detergent on the first day, but when I used powder detergent, some detergent powder got on the dishes, so I bought a new solid detergent and ran it and it works well without that at all. At first, I was slow because I didn't know how to stack the dishes, but now after running it a few times, I'm used to it and I'm putting them in a good arrangement that cleans well. Sentence (English): First, I live single so I don't use the dishwasher often.
Comments (English): [ This is a great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || First, I live single so I don't use the dishwasher often. I have had it long enough now to have used it about 8 times and so far I am very pleased. The dishwasher has a very sleek design and is very easy to use. The dishes come out clean and dry and I have only ever used the shorter one-hour cycle which is more than enough to do the job. I have hard water and my previous dishwasher left hard water deposits on my dishes and I have not experienced that with this one. I love that the interior is stainless steel. This was a must for me and the interior is also clean after a cycle completes, without water spots remaining on the steel. I know this is a small thing but it matters to me. When the cycle completes, it alerts you with a gentle chime. I also like that there are areas on both lower racks where you can fold down portions to accommodate larger objects, which is a very nice detail. It also has a very shallow top rack which is another nice feature. Note to self and all others who have not had a top rack before - do not put lids in it - they will capture and retain a ton of water. Now I know! This dishwasher is also wireless enabled though I have not downloaded the app nor used it. I simply have no need. Although the dishwasher is relatively quiet and comparable to my old one, I have heard it make a wide variety of strange noises while it's running and the sounds can vary from load to load, which is a bit odd. I guess maybe this has something to do with the way it was loaded? And although I already mentioned some nice feature of all of the racks, they feel a bit flimsier than I would expect and I therefore have not and will not load it to capacity.

Sentence (English): I replaced my 14 year old Maytag with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great machine ] || ---------------- || I replaced my 14 year old Maytag with this dishwasher. It's exceptionally quiet. I put just about everything in the dishwasher, from silverware to pots and pans. The exceptions are some plastics and sharp knives. The only noise I get is from the water jets hitting the inside of the pots and pans. It does a much better job of cleaning the inside of tall glasses and jars than my old machine did, and the cleaning cycle is pretty quick. The Auto Air function helps complete the drying of both plastics and ceramics. The only place it falls short is cleaning stainless pots and pans that have any cooked-on material like stir fry remnants. (I'm using the same dishwasher detergent as my old machine.) And as far as I can tell, there is no "Air Dry Only" option if I have plastics that I don't want to get heated. All in all, a great appliance, though.

Sentence (English): I purchased this particular dishwasher based on the superb online reviews.
Comments (English): [ Great Until It Quit ] || ---------------- || I purchased this particular dishwasher based on the superb online reviews. The unit operated and cleaned even the toughest dishes for 11 months. It's so quiet that I wasn't always sure it was running. Then, one day, the dishwasher wouldn't start. The display would show the time, then quickly count down by 10s and stop. I followed the troubleshooting guide—reset, unplug, cut the power, etc. Nothing solved the problem. A serviceman from our retailer came and couldn't figure it out. He even had a Bosch technician on the phone. They couldn't get the unit into "diagnostic mode." So, they are replacing all electronic boards—wifi, controller, etc. That would be OK, except not all boards are in stock. We've been without a dishwasher for at least one month while waiting. Why not just replace the dishwasher when you don't know the problem? I'm very disappointed in Bosch's reliability and maintenance.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher had some unique features we thought might made it a great choice.
Comments (English): [ Wanted to love it.  ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher had some unique features we thought might made it a great choice. Price was competitive but not a deciding factor. After it finally arrived I decided to install myself, same as the last five. It turned out to be a rather difficult installation. The water input is directly blocked so a special elbow is required; very little tightening space to get a wrench in. Electrical hook-up was also challenging compared to others I've installed. The supplied drain hose was not compatible with the standard type so back to the store at 7pm. Once up and running it functioned okay. Cycles take much longer than on previous units. The "hour wash" definitely takes twice that time. The glasses rack must be fully removed from the sliders to adjust the height; extremely inconvenient. The spacing in the bottom rack does not make sense for most dishes in my cupboards. They are also not angled thoughtfully resulting in plates falling on top of each other. The silverware holder is a good design, however.After a few weeks I noticed water on the kitchen floor every time it ran. After checking all hose connections (which were good) the issue was traced back to gasket on the door not sealing allowing water penetration during the wash cycles. We have to keep a container under this area in order to use it.As a Quality Manager in a larger manufacturing facility, the issues this unit has appear to not be manufacturing defects but rather poor design and planning. I would imagine the Design-FMEA was poorly executed which should have anticipated most of these issues. My next dishwasher will not be from GE.

Sentence (English): Our new favorite toy.
Comments (English): [ A little wonder ] || ---------------- || Our new favorite toy. What a chasm in 15 years in terms of improvements, silence and efficiency. We even thought it was a fault when we launched it the first time. Dishwasher delivered and tested just before delivery. It leaves a few drops inside but it reassures us about Bosch's concern to deliver a tested and functional product before delivery. First time I've seen this with a seller. We are just amazed by the quality and functionality of this high-tech device. Furthermore, I, who hated the high cutlery basket, have become the best of friends: it has really been thought out and studied and avoids bending down to put/retrieve the cutlery in a basket below. The Zeolith stone drying system and automatic opening at the end of the cycle is so practical and natural. You really had to think about it before: it's just essential. Remote control with Alexa could be greatly improved: when you ask to start the dishwasher, it only turns it on but does not start the program. A lack of communication to be detailed and filled in your manual. A little expensive to buy anyway and when we see the speculative manipulations on the cost of electricity in France, we are certainly not going to use it every day. We do not regret our purchase. Was the extended warranty really necessary though? Deutsche Qualitat obliges!
Comments (Original): [ Une petite merveille ] || ---------------- || Notre nouveau jouet favoris. Quelle gouffre en 15 ans en terme d'améliorations, de silence et d'efficacité. On a même cru à un défaut quand on l'a lancé la première fois. Lave vaissele livré et testé juste avant la livraison. Ca laisse quelques gouttes à l'intérieur mais ça nous tranquilise sur le soucis de Bosch de nous livrer un produit testé et fonctionnel avant la livraison. Première fois que je vois cela avec un vendeur. Nous sommes juste bluffés par la qualité et les fonctionalités de cet appareil high tech. De plus, moi qui detestait le panier en hauteur des couverts, on est devenus les meilleurs amis du monde: il a vraiment été pensé et étudié et évite de se baisser à mettre/récupérer les couverts dans un panier en contrebas. Le système de séchage à pierre Zeolith et l'ouverture automatique en fin de cycle est tellement pratique et naturel. Il fallait vraiment y penser avant: c'est juste indispensable. La commande à distance avec Alexa pourait être largement améliorée : quand on demande de lancer le lave vaisselle, il ne fait que l'allumer mais ne lance pas le programme. Un manque de communication à détailler et combler dans votre manuel. Un peu cher à l'achat quand même et quand on voit les manipulations spéculatives sur le coût de l'électricité en France, on ne va certainement pas l'utiliser tout les jours. On ne regrette pas notre achat. L'extension de garantie était elle vraiment nécessaire par contre ? Deutsche Qualitat oblige !?

It also seemed to compensate for any shortcomings. At the same time, I was starting to feel stressed about the ever-increasing amount of dishes, so I decided to consider buying one. When the whole family lived together, I didn't do any, and when I lived alone, I did a small amount, so I didn't feel burdened. But now that I'm a two-person household, the amount of dishes, no matter how often I do them, feels more than double. Washing the dishes took at least 20 minutes, and my wrists and legs hurt, and the thought of wasting all that time was incredibly stressful. There were many other brands, but I chose Minix after seeing the most ads, reading reviews, and considering its longevity, after-sales service, and the fact that it came with a dedicated dishwasher detergent tablet. Since this was my first dishwasher purchase, I didn't know much about it. Even small appliances are expensive, and I knew I wanted to use them for a long time. I couldn't just rely on cheap prices or design, so I had to carefully consider the components, performance, and service. After receiving it, installing it, and using it, I was amazed at how much cleaner it was than doing it by hand. Most importantly, I was able to save time by using the time I had for other household chores, and the lack of pressure from washing dishes meant I could cook without worrying about the dishes in the future. I usually eat one or two home-cooked meals a day at work, but the thought of finishing a hard day with dishes often left me sighing. Many people who use dishwashers unanimously agree that their quality of life has improved. Of course, I have to wash frying pans, large pots, and other heat-sensitive containers myself, but I've found that I can quickly and comfortably finish small dishes that don't fit everything else. It's larger than I expected, so it doesn't quite fit in the kitchen, but it does take up a corner, and I think it's the perfect size for two to three people. Overall, I think I made a good purchase at a reasonable price.

Overall, I think I made a good purchase at a reasonable price.

Sentence (English): This is the third dishwasher I've installed in my life and honestly, I can't say there's anything about this one that I would recommend as a benefit.
Comments (English): This is the third dishwasher I've installed in my life and honestly, I can't say there's anything about this one that I would recommend as a benefit. My previous dishwashers had a better layout of the racks, a better utensil, holding tray and better soft touch buttons. The utensil rack will easily allow straws to fall through and get damaged by the dishwasher and the buttons are so sensitive that when the doors open, you can just barely bump them and they start chiming at you with your leg, but then when you go to hit them with your finger if you don't hit them just the right spot or firmer enough they don't work. The first 45 loads had also been doing a very good job of cleaning the dishes so I don't know what was wrong almost like it didn't have a good fill vent maybe? Adjusting of the top rack is terrible. It works fine now but there is nothing about it I like more than either of the previous 2 I installed from LG or whirlpool.

The utensil rack will easily allow straws to fall through and get damaged by the dishwasher and the buttons are so sensitive that when the doors open, you can just barely bump them and they start chiming at you with your leg, but then when you go to hit them with your finger if you don't hit them just the right spot or firmer enough they don't work. The first 45 loads had also been doing a very good job of cleaning the dishes so I don't know what was wrong almost like it didn't have a good fill vent maybe? Adjusting of the top rack is terrible. It works fine now but there is nothing about it I like more than either of the previous 2 I installed from LG or whirlpool.

Comments (English): [ Very good dishwasher so far ] || ---------------- || We owned an 800 series Bosch dishwasher for 8 years before water leaks did it in. While we were hoping to get more life out of that one, we replaced it with this 800 series dishwasher, nonetheless. Our initial impressions were not positive. We previously had an external handle. This time we got the pocket handle and we don't like it as much. The release and handle feel cheap and flimsy. The door itself is lighter weight and also has a cheap feel. The racks are almost identical, which is a positive, except that a set of tynes on the bottom rack that used to fold down do not on the newer version. The other positives of the new one are that it dries much more completely. We are very pleased with that! It also seems quieter even though it's advertised db level is higher than the old one. Lastly, the smell produced by the new washer is rather unpleasant. I can only guess it is because it is new and that it will moderate. We are pleased with the purchase so far and we just want to be honest having now owned two Bosch 800 dishwashers.

The interior light is a nice feature, but really not worth the price difference. There are no other differences between this and the 800, honestly we feel scammed a bit.

Sentence (English): After reading all the negative reviews about people's bad experiences with Costco installation, I almost decided to do the installation myself.
Comments (English): [ Love everything about it! ] || ---------------- || After reading all the negative reviews about people's bad experiences with Costco installation, I almost decided to do the installation myself. However, I'm not very handy, and right now in my life I don't have the time or patience to learn these skills. So I let Costco's contractor do it. Our installation was done by a guy named Frank, a general contractor who does appliance installations through a company called "Jersey Strong Install". Frank did an absolutely outstanding job. He is professional, courteous, and highly-skilled. He was done in a little over an hour. I'm so glad I decided to let him do it. There are many parts of the installation that can be tricky or create problems if not done right. My wife and I love this dishwasher! It's super quiet and cleans the dishes extremely well. They come out sparkling clean, even in hard to reach areas that our previous (entry-level GE branded) dishwasher would miss, like deep within tall water bottles and in the straw of our infant's sippy cup. We love the way this Bosch dishwasher looks in our kitchen, and it's clearly well-made with premium components. Some people complain about poor drying performance, but that has NOT been our experience. We're satisfied with the drying performance, even without using the extra options of a) intensive drying (an option you can set via the app on your phone, and b) Crystal Dry. We haven't yet tried either of these options, but we still find the drying performance to be acceptable. We do use a rinse aid, as recommended. Another thing I like is the app that works with the dishwasher. It's nice to be able to see exactly what's going on--which cycle is running, what options are set, how much longer it will take, and how much water and electricity is being used. It's also nice to get a notification on your phone when the dishes are ready. We couldn't be happier with this purchase!
